material_structure: porous Cu surface with dispersed secondary metal species and grain boundaries
mechanistic_rationale: Heteroatom incorporation can tune local electronic structure and modify *CO adsorption strength. Defect-rich Cu sites may increase local *CO retention and promote C-C coupling.
synthesis_description: A Cu precursor and a secondary metal precursor are deposited on a conductive substrate, followed by oxidation and electrochemical activation.
